- Jolene had a busy week and finished an electrical-engineering project the previous week.

- Jolene’s mother died in 2022. Jolene shared a room with a window bench. Her heart-shaped bird pendant, a gift from her mother in Paris in 2010, symbolizes freedom and pursuing goals; Deborah also has a memorial pendant.
- Deborah wants to continue teaching yoga and supporting her community; yoga helped her through a hard time.

- Deborah’s father died suddenly on 25 Jan 2023; family was shell-shocked. Family, memories and an album comforted her. Parents’ wedding photo dated 1993; Deborah and husband aspire to their love, openness and support.
- On 26 Jan, Deborah received a thank-you letter from her yoga group for her positive influence; it reminded her why she loves yoga. She practices in her childhood home’s living room. Her mother read by the window nightly and loved reading and travel. Deborah shared an airplane-window sky photo.

1 Feb 2023, 7:03 pm — Session 3

- Deborah met neighbor Anna at park yoga on 31 Jan; shared yellow sign with family picture. They talked yoga/community.
- Jolene shared purse-and-plant photo; she and partner planned a console game (unconfirmed). Deborah encouraged breathing and remembering why she persists.

4 Feb 2023, 9:48 am — Session 4

- Deborah bonded with Anna. Photos: two women in dance pose; woman on chair. Deborah described Warrior II for strength/focus and seated twist (feet planted, twist with hand on knee, breathe, switch) for back/shoulder tension.
- Jolene read Sapiens; had read Neal Stephenson’s Avalanche in one sitting two weeks earlier. Success despite challenges reinforced hard work.
- Deborah shared flowers from friend during struggle, symbolizing hope, courage, warmth and appreciation.
- Deborah likes a park with forest trail and beach. Jolene shared a summer 2022 Bogotá beach-at-sunset photo with person/surfboard; water calmed her. Deborah reflects by water near her mother’s old home (small island/lone boat photo), bringing her mother’s amulet (photo: woman in white shirt wearing gold-chain necklace). It comforts her; Anna also wears memorial pendant.

9 Feb 2023, 9:03 pm — Session 5

- Deborah encouraged Jolene to draw on strengths, stay in touch and care for herself; Jolene appreciated it and promised.

Jolene enjoys teaming up with partner on engineering projects; both love the work. Photos: hands with rings (his decorative), book/calculator, men outside building.

Deborah said she was available if Jolene needed support, urged self-care and suggested catching up soon. Jolene promised to take care.
